sentences.en: "Aren't you Mexican?" "Yes, though now I live in Argentina."
sentences.zh: 你不是墨西哥人吗？" "是的，不过我现在住在阿根廷。"

sentences.en: Argentina would fit within Brazil 3 times with room to spare.
sentences.zh: 阿根廷可以轻松地被放进巴西三次。

sentences.en: They told me João went to live in Argentina.
sentences.zh: 他们告诉我若昂去了阿根廷生活。
